Upper Text: [When Digivolving] Delete up to 7 play cost's worth of your opponent's Digimon.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with the [D-Brigade] trait gain ＜Blocker＞.

[End of Your Turn][Once Per Turn] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play cards with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait among them up to a total play cost of 7 without paying the costs. Trash the rest.
